visualCharacteristics: Masonry wall of white bordered link cards on an ice band (2/3/4 columns), each with a 9:4 red or photo head showing the date, then title, category, abstract and location.
contentPattern: One row per event: cell 1 = optional picture + day and month paragraphs; cell 2 = h3 with the event link, then category, abstract(s), optional hours and location paragraphs; news rows use one cell (h3 link, category, date, abstract).
usage: Use to list upcoming events (or newsroom items) as a wall of dated link cards.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any event or news listing by authoring one row per item; use newsroom on the white newsroom page below the filter bar.
